description_en: Retrieves the runtime status of a scenario after a stress test starts
description_zh: 场景启动压测后，获取运行时状态
name: GetPtsSceneRunningStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scenario. This is a unique identifier that the system generates after the scenario is created
parameters.help_zh: 场景ID，创建场景后系统生成的唯一表示
parameters.name: scene_id

Code.description_en: The system status code. This parameter is not returned if the request is successful
Code.description_zh: 系统状态码，若成功则不返回该字段

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the scenario was created

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. This parameter is not returned if the request is successful
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: 请求状态码，若成功则不返回该字段

Message.description_en: The error message. This parameter is not returned if the request is successful
Message.description_zh: 错误提示消息，若成功则不返回该字段

ModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the scenario was last modified

Status.description_en:
The status of the scenario. Valid values:

CREATED

SYNCING

SYNC_DONE

UPLOADING

UPLOADED

PREPARING

READY

RUNNING

STOPPING

STOPPED
Status.description_zh:
场景状态。包括：

CREATED
SYNCING
SYNC_DONE
UPLOADING
UPLOADED
PREPARING
READY
RUNNING
STOPPING 
STOPPED

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
是否成功。
true：成功
false：失败
